subject: Acme onboarding: sudden TTFT/p95 regressions impacting payment authorizations
messages:
From: Elaine Chen <elaine@acme-fintech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding check - intermittent failures since 10:00 UTC

Hi Neha / Laura,

We're seeing a spike in first-token latency (TTFT) for our payment authorization calls to Redwood's hosted API starting around 10:00 UTC. Our telemetry shows p50 ~140ms (normal), p95 jumped to ~740ms, and p99 is spiking beyond 2.5s. This correlates with ~6% error rate (gateway timeouts and 502s) on our end and several failed authorizations that blocked onboarding merchants.

Attached is a short log sample (acme_latency_sample.txt) and a client-side trace for two failed transactions. These are hitting the US region (us-west endpoints). We're in a hardened onboarding window and this is causing merchant escalations. Can you triage urgently and share a mitigation plan?

Thanks,
Elaine Chen
Head of Integrations, Acme Fintech

----

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -0000
Subject: FWD: Re: Onboarding check - intermittent failures since 10:00 UTC

SRE/Infra — forwarding Acme's report. High priority: production impact during an active onboarding (deal ACM-4821). Customer reports large regression in TTFT p95/p99 and ~6% errors. They included client traces.

Please investigate whether this is an upstream edge/CDN/TLS handshake regression (seen in other tickets earlier this month) or an internal serving regression. If it's CDN/edge-related, we should confirm POP TLs and certificate handshake timings and consider temporary routing adjustments.

Laura — keep Acme updated; Avery please advise if we should loop in solutions/eng on a short call.

Neha
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 10:33:00 -0000
Subject: Re: FWD: Re: Onboarding check - intermittent failures since 10:00 UTC

Quick triage notes — attaching probe dumps (sre_probe_results.zip) and a packet capture we pulled for one of the slow sessions (trace-2026-06-25.pcap). Initial findings:
- Edge POPs in us-west are showing elevated TLS handshake RTTs starting ~09:55 UTC; SYN/ACK timing consistent with upstream CDN egress variability.
- Backend service (inference workers) are not showing queueing or CPU saturation; per-host token service p50/p95 for generation are within normal ranges.
- Requests that hit affected POPs show first byte delay concentrated before application-level bytes — suggests upstream handshake/CDN egress rather than model execution.

Next steps: (1) confirm CDN provider health and recent certificate rotation events, (2) enable short-term client-side retry guidance for Acme, (3) consider traffic steering away from affected POPs for the customer route. I'm opening a provider ticket now.

-David

----
Attachment: sre_probe_results.zip (zip)
Attachment: trace-2026-06-25.pcap (pcap)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Chen <elaine@acme-fintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:00:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding check - intermittent failures since 10:00 UTC

Hi Elaine — thanks for the sample and flag. We're investigating this with the SRE team now. Early signal points to TLS/EDGE handshake latency in a subset of US edge POPs (not the model hosts).

Temporary mitigation we can enable immediately:
- Client-side: increase HTTP connect/first-byte timeouts to 6s and add exponential backoff on retries (2 retries) for authorization calls. That should reduce user-facing errors while we fix the root cause.
- Server-side: we can steer traffic for your account away from the affected POPs to alternate US POPs; this requires a quick config change and a short routing propagation (5-10 minutes).

Can you confirm whether Acme is able to tolerate a brief routing update? If yes, we can proceed now and keep you updated with probe results.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Suresh Patel <suresh@acme-fintech.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 12:15:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Onboarding check - intermittent failures since 10:00 UTC

Laura / Neha — we can add retries on our client and tolerate a short routing change. Please proceed with the steering and keep the timeboxed plan. We'll enable the retries on our SDK right away and report back on error-rate delta. Thanks.

Suresh Patel
Platform Eng, Acme Fintech
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 18:40:00 -0000
Subject: Post-mortem note: steering completed, CDN provider response pending

Summary and next steps:
- At 12:25 UTC we steered Acme's account away from two us-west POPs showing elevated TLS RTT; routing propagated by 12:35 UTC.
- Acme reported p95 dropped from ~740ms to ~160ms and p99 reduced to ~900ms within 20 minutes; error rate fell to ~0.8%. Client-side retries also reduced visible failures.
- SRE opened ticket with CDN provider referencing increased handshake duration and a likely transient egress node congestion / TLS session resumption degradation. Provider has acknowledged and is investigating a wider POP-level condition.
- Action items: (1) monitor provider remediation and collect longer-term probe data, (2) evaluate adding fallback POP preferences for high-throughput onboarding flows, (3) document retry guidance in onboarding runbook.

I'll prepare a short exec summary and include the probe artifacts for compliance/audit. Good job on the quick steer and customer coordination.

-Vivek
